pr_title: Add Aseprite Format section in the preferences dialog to introduce the "save raw cels" option
pr_body:
Fix #4901

And the caacd8f7fa0ec70dddea83209b5462a673214ee1 commit fixes the setting of the format options for the document when a single file is loaded. It worked for file sequences but not for single files.
pr_comments: It works great, I'll merge it as it is. The only thing I'd like to rethink is the "Aseprite Format" section, it looks like a too advance tweak to be so accessible.

issue_context.title: Add option to generate raw cel chunks in 'ase_file_write_cel_chunk' function
issue_context.body: It would be really nice if there was an option for generating raw cel chunks, especially since the code to generate them exists but is never called.
comments: Hi @makaroneder, thanks for your comment. I think it could be easily added. Probably a new section in *Edit > Preferences > Aseprite Format* to specify this kind of configurations.
